summary: Rejected transit moved before trainer gate
symptom: Ferry travel was rejected by the hard-trainer gate after the NPC seeker had already moved the player from Route 109 x18,y0 to x22,y2

unexpected.predicted: A rejected transit request performs no emulator input and leaves the live state unchanged
unexpected.actual: The request raised trainer_engagement_blocked after movement had already changed the live position

authority.oracle: RunBunAdapter canonical RAM observation and route-gate regression test

steps: deny the complete route in the trainer gate
reproduction.observed: Both runs rejected before any movement call.

root_cause.claim: The NPC seeker applied the trainer gate only to each movement chunk, so the first chunk could mutate the emulator before a later chunk exposed the hard-trainer denial.
evidence: The rejected live ferry request left Route 109 x18,y0 and reached x22,y2 before raising.
The fixed regression denies the full planned route before follow_route.
alternatives_falsified: The checkpoint loader restored the exact verified state hash, so stale-state loading did not cause the partial movement.

solution.contract_change: follow_live_path_to_npc must reject the complete planned path before issuing its first movement chunk; per-chunk checks remain for moving trainers.
solution.workaround: Restore auto-forward-latest.state after any pre-fix partial transit rejection.

replay.expected: A denied route makes no movement call.
replay.actual: Both replay runs denied before follow_route.

domain_knowledge: Transit preflight must be atomic with respect to planned movement.
regression_cases: A denied full NPC route must issue zero movement inputs.
tooling_contracts: follow_live_path_to_npc performs a complete trainer-gate preflight before chunk execution.
